description: This file defines classes and functions for Windows SSPI-based HTTP authentication mechanisms, including SSPI library abstraction, default implementation, and specific HttpAuth mechanism for SSPI. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and external references related to NTLM and Negotiate authentication.

classes.name: SSPILibrary
classes.description: Abstract class representing SSPI library functions for Windows authentication, allowing mocking in tests.

classes.name: SSPILibraryDefault
classes.description: Default implementation of SSPILibrary that calls Windows SSPI functions.

classes.name: HttpAuthSSPI
classes.description: Http authentication mechanism using SSPI for Windows-based NTLM and Negotiate authentication.

methods.name: DetermineMaxTokenLength
methods.description: Determines the maximum token length for a given SSPI package.

methods.name: AcquireCredentialsHandle
methods.description: Obtains a handle to the credentials for SSPI authentication.

methods.name: InitializeSecurityContext
methods.description: Initializes or continues the security context for SSPI.

methods.name: QueryContextAttributesEx
methods.description: Queries extended attributes of the security context.

methods.name: QuerySecurityPackageInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the security package.

methods.name: HttpAuthSSPI
methods.description: Class implementing HTTP auth mechanism using SSPI.
